english.title: Use a motor cycle with tyre less than 1 mm tread
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) used on a road, namely **(..SPECIFY ROAD AND LOCATION..), a motor cycle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..), when the grooves of the tread pattern of a tyre fitted to the **(..SPECIFY WHEEL LOCATION..) wheel of the motor cycle were not of a depth of at least 1mm throughout a continuous band comprising three-quarters of the breadth of the tread and round the entire outer circumference of the tyre
english.legislation: Contrary to regulation 27(1)(g)(i) of the Road Vehicles (Construction and Use) Regulations 1986, section 41A of the Road Traffic Act 1988 and Schedule 2 to the Road Traffic Offenders Act 1988.

other.penalty:
A fine not exceeding level five on the standard scale.

Obligatory endorsement - licence endorsed three penalty points.

Discretionary disqualification.

Fixed penalty ticket - one hundred pounds and licence endorsed three penalty points.

Time limit for prosecutions:
6 months

On the 12th March 2015 the limit on fines imposed by a Magistrates’ court was removed – as such, the potential fine on summary conviction in relation to an offence committed after this date is unlimited.
